$comment: Single source of truth for the port-based local dev services (Git #1782). scripts/dev-all.mjs reads the `services` array to know what to spawn/kill; desktop/BuildConsole/Services/DevServicesManager.cs reads the same array at startup to populate KnownServices, which drives BuildConsole's title-bar Services menu (built dynamically, no fixed XAML/code-behind list). Adding a real artifact here is the only edit needed for it to show up in both places — icon glyphs are cosmetic and stay in a small C#-side lookup, not here. `basePath` (Git #3085) is the explicit local-dev mount base dev-all.mjs passes as BASE_PATH; omitted/absent means the historical flat "/" default. `portal` carries one matching its real production mount (`.replit` line 58, `artifacts/portal/.replit-artifact/artifact.toml` BASE_PATH) so local dev, Staging, and Production agree explicitly instead of local relying on vite.config.ts's own unset/`/`-BASE_PATH self-heal fallback. `admin-panel` also carries one (Git #4100) — its vite.config.ts self-mounts at `/admin-panel/` as its own canonical default even with BASE_PATH unset, so this documents that real, always-on mount rather than a value dev-all.mjs actually passes as an env var. `msp-console` carries the same shape (Git #4101) — its vite.config.ts self-mounts at `/msp-console/` as MSP_CONSOLE_CANONICAL_BASE when BASE_PATH is unset/`/`.

excluded.name: mcp-server
excluded.reason: Git #1782 investigation: artifacts/mcp-server has no "dev" script (package.json only defines start/typecheck/e2e) and artifacts/mcp-server/src/index.ts connects via StdioServerTransport, not an HTTP listener on a port. It's a stdio MCP server with no port/URL concept, so it doesn't fit the port-based Vite/api-server shape this config and dev-all.mjs assume. Not included until/unless it grows a real dev-server treatment of its own.
